anchors.exact_quote: The pump draws the oil from the sump in the base frame, and on the pressure side the oil passes through the lubricating oil cooler and the filter which both are mounted on the engine. Cooling is carried out by the low temperature cooling water system and the temperature regulating is made by a thermostatic 3-way valve on the oil side. The engine is as standard equipped with an electrically driven prelubricating pump.
